verdict.rationale: AssemblyAI documents a models page listing distinct options: a primary model set with automatic fallback to Universal-2 for 99-language coverage, a Medical Mode add-on, and keyterms or contextual prompting. It also publishes a ~150ms p50 latency figure for streaming. However, the evidence shows no side-by-side accuracy, latency and cost comparison to guide model choice, and community commenters noted the absence of published WER benchmarks (in older threads). missing for 10: published accuracy/WER figures per model, per-model cost tradeoffs, latency figures for non-streaming models, independent corroboration.
